text:
Alex K: Quick status check — Optimize toolkit delivery: quant recommendations PR is in draft, pushed tests, need infra signoff for GPU runs. cc @Sasha P and @Maya R
Maya R: Thanks. Can you drop the PR link?
Alex K: https://github.com/redwood/optimize/pull/842 — contains quant profiles + batching hints
Sasha P: I'll queue a perf job tomorrow morning. FYI infra has a compute window 03/20 02:00-06:00 UTC we can use.
Lina: Who's owning the canary rollout and rollback hooks? We should name an owner before prod changes.
Jevon: I can take canary ownership for the initial week. Will set up latency + quality alerts in Console.
Alex K: Awesome. Jevon — can you add a 99th-pct latency alert and a quality-regression alert?
Jevon: Yep. Tentative alert names: optkit_canary_latency (p99>350ms), optkit_canary_quality (delta>3%). I'll also add runbook pointers.
Maya R: Need to pin the quantized model variant in deployment config — propose model=rw-quant-v2, batch_size=8, prefix_cache=true. Anyone object?
Alex K: No objections. Config snippet for ops:
```yaml
model: rw-quant-v2
batching:
  max_batch: 8
  prefix_cache: true
kv_cache: enabled
```
Maya R: Also, QA flagged two diffs in optkit-regress-07 yesterday. @Alex K can you triage?
Alex K: On it. Preliminary looks like a tokenizer change in the last commit causing tokenization boundary shifts. Will try rolling back that tokenizer patch in a branch.
Sasha P: Any blockers from SRE for autoscaler change? We need a smaller target_min for better utilization during canary.
infra-bot: Autoscaler change approved in dev; prod approval requires infra ticket INF-3291.
Sasha P: Filed INF-3291, assigned to @Sasha P, ETA 48h for review.
Lina: CR ping: @Alex K needs to review PR 842 final before merge.
Alex K: Reviewing now — will merge after CI passes and perf job looks clean.
Sasha P: Perf job snapshot: quant + batching lowered cost per token ~12% and reduced tail latency variability. p50 is roughly same. Full logs: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/optkit/842/perf-20250319.log
Jevon: Canary rollout plan after merge: start 2025-03-22T02:00Z, ramp 10% -> 50% over 6h, monitor p99 latency, error-rate, and optkit-regress set. Owner: Jevon, backup: Maya R.
Lina: Noted. Please add rollback thresholds for error-rate >0.5% sustained or p99>500ms.
Alex K: Action items recap: Jevon = canary + alerts + runbook; Sasha = prod autoscaler approval + perf jobs; Alex = triage regressions + merge PR; Maya = monitor evals and post summary.
Maya R: Add me to the runbook and the alert notification list.
Jevon: Will post runbook snippet here after I finish alert configs.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deployment job for 2025-03-22T02:00Z (job id 5591).
Alex K: :thumbsup: Thanks all — ping here for any immediate regressions or if infra ticket blocks prod rollout.
